radicato.prompt: The second image is the reference sheet of the man. Edit the first image, two nights later. Now he sits at the far end of the kitchen table on the right, on the green plastic chair, facing the viewer, perfectly still, his forearms resting on the flowered tablecloth. His skin has become grey and dry, cracked all over in small plates like old bark or dry clay; his eyes are covered by a milky white film; his mouth hangs half open, dry and grey; his fingers have grown very long and thin, dark brown and knotted like roots, and they have pushed through the tablecloth into the wood of the table, spreading in thin cracks across it. In front of him on the table stands a white cup of coffee, untouched. He is still clearly the same man, with the same face and the same denim jacket, now stiff and dusty. The young woman with the blanket in the doorway at the back stays exactly identical, in the same place.
